snippet.title: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 - Concept Gameplay Trailer (AI Soundtrack)
snippet.description:
🟢 Wishlist JUST MADNESS: EARTH APOCALYPSE 1979 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652470/Just_Madness_Earth_Apocalypse_1979/

ABOUT THIS VIDEO:This is an older gameplay concept trailer from the early stages of development (previously known as Max Madness).

The background track is an energetic 1970s/1980s rock experiment created with AI music tools, featuring lyrics that connect directly with the game's psychological atmosphere:

"It's a new world so cold / No one can hear my soul / Where are you in the glow / My madness starts to grow..."

A Brand New Official Trailer is currently in production and will be released soon. Subscribe and turn on notifications to catch it first!

ABOUT THE GAME:
Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 is an atmospheric survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore harsh environments, manage your scarce resources, and survive the horrors of the wasteland.

🔗 Follow our development journey:

Crowdfunding Campaign: https://www.rodrigobanzato.com/

IndieDB/ModDB: https://www.indiedb.com/members/rodrigobanzato/games

Website: rodrigobanzato.com
